⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The fresh food refrigerator section is warm (50°F+), while the lower back panel inside the freezer is coated in heavy white frost or ice and airflow from the top vents is weak.

Verified technical root cause: The 12-inch glass tube defrost heater at the bottom of the freezer evaporator coil has burned out, causing ice to completely block the airflow ducts to the refrigerator side.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Unplug the refrigerator, remove the shelves from the freezer, and unscrew the rear interior freezer wall panel to expose the frosted aluminum evaporator coils.
  2. Look at the glass quartz tube heater (WR51X10055) clipped across the bottom of the coils: if the glass is blackened inside or shows open continuity on a multimeter, the heater is burned out.
  3. Melt the ice off the coils with a hair dryer on low, clip in the new WR51X10055 defrost heater and WR55X10025 thermistor kit, and reassemble.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Fridge Warm + Frost on Freezer Back Wall)

Why is my freezer still freezing food while the fridge side gets warm?
All cold air in a refrigerator is made in the freezer and blown into the fridge compartment through a top damper. When the WR51X10055 defrost heater fails, frost packs the evaporator fins solid so the fan can no longer push cold air over to the fridge side.
